categories.fruit: General Fruit Tip: Conventionally grown fruit with thin, edible skins usually carry higher pesticide loads. Opt for organic when possible.
categories.beef: General Beef Tip: Look for '100% grass-fed and finished' for optimal omega fatty acid ratios.

foods.name: Apples
foods.meta: High in pectin and fiber. A great source of antioxidants if the skin is consumed.
foods.avoid: Conventionally grown apples (frequently top the dirty dozen list). Avoid wax-coated varieties.

foods.name: Avocados
foods.meta: Packed with monounsaturated fats and potassium.
foods.avoid: Avocados that feel mushy or have air pockets under the skin.
